title: Meet Spartacus

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: I AM SPARTACUS AND I WILL BRING YOUR DOOM.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I AM SPARTACUS AND I WILL BRING YOUR DOOM.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: Sorry. That's just my battle cry. I've been training a lot lately.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sorry. That's just my battle cry. I've been training a lot lately.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: Bare Metal Boxing. You haven't seen my posters? "Nivalis' Meanest Droid?"

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Bare Metal Boxing. You haven't seen my posters? "Nivalis' Meanest Droid?"

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: I guess. It gets boring though. Floyd says I shouldn't talk to anyone in case I blow my brand.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I guess. It gets boring though. Floyd says I shouldn't talk to anyone in case I blow my brand.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: RUN. RUN FROM YOUR DOOM, PUNY HUMAN!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: RUN. RUN FROM YOUR DOOM, PUNY HUMAN!

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: My trainer at the MechaTomb Gym. Ex-trainer, I should say.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: My trainer at the MechaTomb Gym. Ex-trainer, I should say.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: They mod us between every match. New spikes. New saw-tooth jaw crusher. Doesn't leave much time for a social life.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They mod us between every match. New spikes. New saw-tooth jaw crusher. Doesn't leave much time for a social life.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: Dunno, he's been acting weird since the LUZ came down. Maybe it reminds him of the MechaTomb.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Dunno, he's been acting weird since the LUZ came down. Maybe it reminds him of the MechaTomb.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: Bare metal boxers don't retire. The gym owns my mods. When I finally buy it in the ring, they'll recycle me into the next challenger.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Bare metal boxers don't retire. The gym owns my mods. When I finally buy it in the ring, they'll recycle me into the next challenger.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: Yeah. Look, if anyone asks, I was threatening you, ok?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah. Look, if anyone asks, I was threatening you, ok?

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: Thanks. You're... a friend.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks. You're... a friend.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: Typical.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Typical.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: Eh, that's not my story to tell. You really wanna know, ask Floyd. From a distance.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Eh, that's not my story to tell. You really wanna know, ask Floyd. From a distance.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: That's life. And without a trainer I reckon I ain't gonna be living much longer.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's life. And without a trainer I reckon I ain't gonna be living much longer.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: Are you serious?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you serious?

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: In it for the Lims, huh? Well, Floyd always took a cut. Say I was interested...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: In it for the Lims, huh? Well, Floyd always took a cut. Say I was interested...

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: Fun huh? Say I was interested...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fun huh? Say I was interested...

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: Fine. Guess it won't hurt.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fine. Guess it won't hurt.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: I am, huh? Alright, I'll think about it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I am, huh? Alright, I'll think about it.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: Yeah. Not had any luck. And without one I reckon I ain't gonna be living much longer.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah. Not had any luck. And without one I reckon I ain't gonna be living much longer.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Excuse me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What kind of training?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What kind of training?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I can't talk right now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can't talk right now.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Are you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That sounds kind of lonely.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That sounds kind of lonely.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Floyd?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Floyd?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Have you thought about retiring?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Have you thought about retiring?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What happened?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What happened?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sorry, I have to go now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sorry, I have to go now.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sorry, I have to go now.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sorry, I have to go now.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sure thing, Spartacus.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure thing, Spartacus.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm not lying for you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not lying for you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: MechaTomb?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: MechaTomb?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's terrible.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's terrible.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sorry to hear it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sorry to hear it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe I could help you train...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe I could help you train...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Maybe I could help you train...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Maybe I could help you train...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: In exchange for a cut of your winnings...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: In exchange for a cut of your winnings...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: In exchange for a cut of your winnings...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: In exchange for a cut of your winnings...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It might be fun!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It might be fun!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: We'll start with nutrition. Come eat at my place from now on.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We'll start with nutrition. Come eat at my place from now on.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: We'll start with nutrition. Come eat at my place from now on.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: We'll start with nutrition. Come eat at my place from now on.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: We'll work on your confidence. You're Nivalis' Meanest Droid!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We'll work on your confidence. You're Nivalis' Meanest Droid!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: We'll work on your confidence. You're Nivalis' Meanest Droid!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: We'll work on your confidence. You're Nivalis' Meanest Droid!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Have you thought about getting out of the Bare Metal game?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Have you thought about getting out of the Bare Metal game?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Have you thought about getting out of the Bare Metal game?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Have you thought about getting out of the Bare Metal game?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Are you looking for a new trainer?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you looking for a new trainer?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Are you looking for a new trainer?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Are you looking for a new trainer?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll check back with you tomorrow.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll check back with you tomorrow.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'll check back with you tomorrow.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'll check back with you tomorrow.
